fields.why: The Table note says 'Data are not presented for cells with sample size <10', and the CSV shows suppressed cells ('— ¶') for AI/AN, unknown race, in-hospital death and others; the brief classes suppression of observed values as a transformation.

Age groups are assessed only by ratios against 18–49 years (per-group vs referent), but race/ethnicity groups are ranked ('highest among AI/AN ... and Black') in Figure 2, with ratios computed only for two groups against two referents, so side by side (resolving to finer) fits race better; A's per-group reading of race is defensible.

brief_issues: A groupwise result that both ranks all groups and gives ratios for only some of them against more than one referent fits neither assessment value cleanly; a rule naming which takes precedence would help.
